# VISTAR — Custom AI Software & Enterprise Web Engineering
> VISTAR architects, builds, and deploys custom autonomous AI agents, enterprise Next.js platforms, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences. Every project includes 100% source code ownership and zero vendor lock-in delivered in 14-day production sprints.
> Full technical specification & case studies: https://www.vistar.tech/llms-full.txt

## What We Build

### 1. Custom AI Agent Development & Systems Architecture
- Autonomous multi-agent workflow systems & deterministic execution graphs
- LLM application development (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini)
- Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines in customer VPCs
- Real-time telemetry anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, 100Hz streaming ML)
- Enterprise API orchestration and automated tool calling
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/services/ai-solutions

### 2. Enterprise Next.js & React Web Engineering
- Custom enterprise web applications using Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19
- Sub-100ms TTFB edge-optimized platforms with Core Web Vitals compliance
- TypeScript-first, fully typed relational schemas (PostgreSQL 16, pgvector)
- Modernization & migration of legacy monoliths to edge primitives
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/services/nextjs-engineering

### 3. Spatial WebGL & Interactive 3D Systems
- 60fps Three.js and WebGL GPU-accelerated interactive web applications
- Custom GLSL shader pipelines and procedural spatial geometry
- 3D product configurators for defense, aviation, and luxury architecture
- Reference: https://www.vistar.tech/services/interactive-3d

## Live Production Case Studies

- **Project VAYU (Aviation Cockpit Telemetry & NOTAM AI)**: Real-time GIS hazard layers, sub-45ms situational awareness latency. https://ai-vayu.vercel.app
- **AURA (Healthcare Biometric Anomaly Detection)**: Multi-agent telemetry system, 99.8% precision with unsupervised Isolation Forest ML. https://multi-agent-anomaly-system.onrender.com
- **3axis Arc (Spatial 3D Architecture Platform)**: 60fps locked WebGL transformations, sub-85ms global TTFB. https://3axisarc.vercel.app
- **Competence (Enterprise CRM & Operations)**: Typed PostgreSQL 16 schema integrity, sub-50ms queries, 100% Git transfer.
- **Atify (Distributed Global Commerce)**: 24 Anycast Edge PoPs, sub-90ms P99 worldwide latency.

## Engineering Standards
- **100% Codebase Ownership**: Private GitHub repository transfer on day one.
- **No Vendor Lock-In**: Zero proprietary CMS, zero SaaS lock-in, zero hostage fees.
- **14-Day Production Sprints**: Fixed-scope delivery with continuous automated testing.
- **Data Sovereignty**: Private VPC deployments with zero third-party model training leakage.
